newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound gained slightly against the dollar on Tuesday in a private sector market slightly short of the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"The market's still slightly short of dollars," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3865 and 3.3890 pounds bid, and between 3.3910 and 3.3930 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average rate on Tuesday was 3.3876 pounds bid and 3.3920 pounds offered in the interbank market, compared to 3.3901 pounds bid and 3.3923 pounds offered on the Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.386802 pounds buy and 3.391855 pounds sell.
